digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and testing guidance documentation
propositions: Flaky (nondeterministic) tests must be debugged to root cause using /rebar-debug workflow, not retried until they pass, because repeated rechecks waste tokens and erode CI as a regression oracle.

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently offer recheck as a remedy for failures that 'look transient/flaky' without distinguishing environmental faults from test nondeterminism, creating a self-contradiction.
The recheck mechanism should be reserved for provably environmental faults (TLS cert flakes, missing CI dispatch, runner outage) where the reasoning is stated in the recheck comment.
Documentation must be reconciled so both AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md §6 name the two cases explicitly and cross-link rather than duplicate guidance.
A test must pin that the rule is present and that the old retry-until-green licence is absent from the guidance.
